prompt_head:
Job: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
- (required) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, implementation, or SaaS opera

output.angle: Position Tylor as a hands-on systems architect whose automated validation pipelines, client onboarding integrations, and operations CRM work map directly onto CentralReach's configuration-heavy, detail-driven role.
posting_hooks: Provisioning and configuring customer accounts across internal systems, backed by the linkme-intops operations CRM for high-value accounts
Building validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors, matching the attention-to-detail requirement
Onboarding high-value enterprise clients through integration blueprints and live demo environments
